Interface GameResult

All Known Implementing Classes:
PracticeResult
public interface GameResult
Common contract for the summary produced at the end of any game session.

Callers (e.g. the UI layer) that only need to know whether a session finished and which mode it was depend on this interface. Mode-specific data (score, winner, rounds) is accessed by casting to PracticeResult or

invalid reference 
BattleResult
, or via the visitor / pattern-match idiom.
